problem_text:
A logistics company needs to schedule 4 delivery routes through 4 distribution centers.

Each route consists of a sequence of handling stages represented as (Center, Duration) pairs, where each pair specifies the distribution center where the stage must occur and the time required. The order of pairs indicates the required sequence for handling stages.

Route details:
* R1 requires the sequence: (C3, 10) → (C2, 1) → (C1, 1) → (C4, 5)
* R2 requires the sequence: (C2, 7) → (C1, 9) → (C4, 3) → (C3, 5)
* R3 requires the sequence: (C1, 5) → (C2, 3) → (C4, 9) → (C3, 2)
* R4 requires the sequence: (C3, 7) → (C2, 2) → (C4, 2) → (C1, 9)

Each handling stage must run continuously once it begins and cannot be interrupted, and each distribution center can only handle one stage at a time. The objective is to determine the processing order of all stages at the distribution centers so that the total completion time for all routes is minimized.
